mira: Quick smoke check: I'm trying to onboard `ara-v2` and noticed the model config points to a GCS weights URI but our asset pipeline expects s3 URIs. Can someone confirm if the asset-mapper ran for this artifact?

mira: Config snippet pasted below — reported by the onboarding job:
```json
{
  "model_name": "ara-v2",
  "weights_uri": "gs://redwood-models/ara/v2/weights.tar.gz",
  "tokenizer": { "type": "hf-bpe", "vocab_path": "gs://redwood-models/ara/v2/tokenizer.json", "offset": 1 }
}
```

alex: I saw that — the asset-mapper step didn't run on the release tag (looks like CI skip). Short term: change to the s3 path we mirror: `s3://artifacts.redwood/models/ara/v2/weights.tar.gz` and same for tokenizer. Longer term we should make the mapper idempotent in the onboarding job. :+1:

config-lint-bot: config-lint: Warning for `ara-v2` — tokenizer.offset != 0 (value=1). This can cause subtoken index shift vs runtime vocab (rule: tokenizer.offset should default to 0). See docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/serving/tokenizer-compat

ryan: FWIW we hit this with a HF-sourced tokenizer before — some tokenizers include a reserved BOS so the file uses a 1-shifted index. Two options: 1) normalize the tokenizer file to remove the extra reserved token (preferred), or 2) set `tokenizer.offset=1` and add a compatibility shim in the serving runtime. I prefer normalizing to avoid runtime shims.

jen: I'll take a tiny PR to add a schema-level default for `tokenizer.offset` (0) and a lint rule that flags nonzero offsets with a required justification field. That should reduce silent mismatches. I'll also file a follow-up to make the asset-mapper step non-skippable for onboarding flows.

mira: Sounds good — I'll update the weights/tokenizer URIs to s3 and open the PR to normalize the tokenizer. I'll ping @jen when it's ready and attach the CI run. Thanks all! :rocket:

dev-bot: CI pipeline queued: onboarding-smoke/ara-v2 (job id: 45231) — will post results here when complete.
